name: Diane Arbus: Konstellationen
description: The most comprehensive exhibition of Diane Arbus' work to date, featuring 454 prints, many shown for the first time. Presented as a labyrinthine constellation, the exhibition invites visitors to discover resonances between Arbus' iconic images and the wide range of her portraiture, from New York pedestrians to drag performers to celebrities. Arbus is regarded as one of the most original and influential artists of the 20th century.
